Roughly two hours later, inside of an unsuspecting and nondescript building full of nubile flesh.
scene stripswimwar1
Now that both dates have come to an end and I have kissed both competitors, I am finally ready to make a decision in regard to which one I would like to continue kissing.
Or just whoever had the better date, which I believe is the entire point of the competition, but I’ll choose however I want to choose because that is what it means to be free.
First, though, I must figure out why we are at a strip club.
: I have a question.
: Is it about why we’re at a strip club?
: You know me so well, Ayane.
: This is where we finished up the Dorm Wars last year. And we figured coming back here would be the safest way to keep Imani from finding out.
: Plus, the distinct lack of males in this city has all but run this business into the ground! They’ll take anything they can get at this point.
: Right. And the police tape?
: That was here when we showed up. It’s probably nothing. Just try and go under it if you can so we don’t disturb the crime scene.
: But wouldn’t crossing it and hanging out inside of said crime scene-
: Blah blah blah. That’s a problem for future 1-A. For now, we proceed!
: And we do so in highly controversial fashion as this is the most up-front we’ve ever been about our mutual interest in you! What could possibly go wrong?
: Everything. Which I am sure you are already aware of, so I guess we should just get the ball rolling then.
scene stripswimwar2
: Two girls — two dates! And for the first time in Dorm Wars history, we won’t ask for any details!
: We’ll just silently wonder what happened until our friends cave and explain everything to us later on!
: Sensei and I found a portal to Hell.
scene stripswimwar3
: Damn. And I thought I had a good time.
: I am no longer silently wondering. I am wondering out loud.
: Well, wonder later. Because, from what I understand, everything that is about to happen inside of this room revolves around me and I am too much of a narcissist to wait any longer.
scene stripswimwar4
: The winner of this year’s date war...
menu:
Rin
: ...is Rin Rokuhara.
scene stripswimwar5
: Really? Even though all we did was sit in my room? Was Hell really that terrifying?
: I had a great time with both of you. And yes, Io’s date was far more exciting. But it was more...exploration than an actual “date” to me I guess.
scene stripswimwar6
: It’s okay, Io...there will be more. Like, maybe you can show me what you guys found next-
: You don’t need to cheer me up, Uta. I already knew I was going to lose.
scene stripswimwar7
: The contest portion doesn’t really matter, though. I’m just glad there was finally a part of this event that I didn’t inherently despise. Thanks for that, Sensei.
: Thank you. Both of you, actually. I had a lot of fun this year.
: This wasn’t an easy choice.

Io
: ...is Io Ichimonji.
scene stripswimwar8
: But...I’m Io Ichimonji.
: You’re Io Ichimonji the winner now! I told you you had a shot! See?!
: No, I think Sensei just forgot my name. Or he remembered my name and said the wrong one on accident.
: I didn’t say anything on accident. It’s just hard to lose when you make a discovery like we did. And it was a very Io date, all things considered.
: That just makes it sound even worse.
: Welp...it...is what it is, I guess.
scene stripswimwar9
: Can’t really compete with a...portal to Hell.
: I obviously had a great time with you too, Rin. I’ll remember both of these dates for a long time.
: I’m just reluctant to say “forever” because forever is constantly expanding and the likelihood of me remembering anything at all gets slimmer every single day.
: Either way, it wasn’t an easy choice.

$ iodatewin = True
Ayane
: ...is Ayane Amamiya.
scene stripswimwar10
: Again?! But I wasn’t even there this time!
: Which makes it all the more impressive that you managed to win.
: I feel like there has to be some kinda rule against this.
: We can’t let you always just pick whoever you want even if they’re not an option, Sensei. If we do that, your secret OG love squad thingy will just always win.
scene stripswimwar11
: How do you even know about the love squad? I thought that’s just what they called each other.
: I’m the new gossip queen now that Chika is broken. I know everything.
: Sensei...I’m really happy that you keep choosing me for stuff, but-
: If Ayane doesn’t win, nobody wins. Both Io and Rin’s dates were too close to choose from, so I need to go with Ayane. Or Uta if Ayane won’t accept the win.
scene stripswimwar12
: You know, maybe it’s okay to let people who aren’t in the running be chosen sometimes. I will gladly accept this victory since Ayane won’t-
: I accept. And I will...absolutely repay you for this soon. I promise.
: There’s no need to “repay” me for anything when I’m the one repaying you right now.
: Either way, it wasn’t an easy choice.

: But it’s the choice I made and I’m going to stick by it.
scene stripswimwar13
: Now — bring on all of the attention. Just not if it’s going to devolve into a massive fight between all of you. Which it may.
: We’ll get started with the model marathon in a sec. I’ll tell Tsuneyo and Sana to go get dressed.
scene stripswimwar14
: Io — you wanted to leave though, right?
: When the alternative is to hang out in a strip club and watch people I don’t like strip? Yes. I am going to leave.
scene stripswimwar15
: Thanks for including me this time, though. I hereby agree to participate in all contests where I get to associate only with Sensei. Or Uta.
: Goodbye.
scene stripswimwar16
: Uhh...forgive her. Io’s not really built for this kind of stuff.
: I don’t think any of us really expected her to stick around anyway. Especially not after last year.
: I’m just confused. I didn’t think straight girls were allowed to wear denim jackets.
scene black
After taking a moment to tally up the scores and update the apparent Dorm Wars app (which is also a thing now), the girls lead me inside the main room.
It seems like most of the class has shown up, but there are several notable exceptions.
Probably those who were rightfully uncomfortable about the idea of openly competing for my love and affection when it’s been mostly a secretive thing so far.
Of course a secret like this would never last forever, though. And of course it was always going to lead to something like this.
I just figured there’d be more bloodshed and less...friendly competition.
I guess there’s still time for the former, though.
scene stripswimwar17
Especially if people like Nodoka, who are well-versed in the act of starting problems, are here.
: Well, if it isn’t the man of the hour.
: Hey. You feeling any better today?
: Are you implying that I was unwell yesterday?
: By your standards, yeah. Because you not only fell asleep on my shoulder, but looked very cute while doing so. You’re not supposed to be cute. You’re supposed to be Nodoka.
: And Nodoka isn’t cute?
: No. Just creepily seductive and situationally hot.
: Hm.
scene stripswimwar18
: I suppose I am feeling “better” then. Though, I’m not quite sure that’s how I’d describe it myself.
: Well...how would you, then?
: Akira — have you ever touched the bottom of a swimming pool?
: All the time. Huge hobby of mine.
: Then, as someone with far more experience than me, surely I don’t need to inform you of the high that accompanies such a simple feat.
: There’s this moment, you see — where you feel nothing at all. And you’re drifting from the top to the bottom, suspended in a position of wet uncertainty.
: Wet uncertainty. Couldn’t have said it better myself.
scene stripswimwar19
: That transitory state of being, sandwiched between a beginning and an end, is one I’ve grown comfortable in. But there has always been this...desire.
: To empty my lungs of air. To touch the bottom of the pool — just to see how it feels. Just to know that I can.
: I believe I did that yesterday. And I believe that means I can now float safely back to the surface and feel the sun on my skin once more.
scene stripswimwar20
: Can you open your eyes underwater, Akira? Because I can. And I barely notice a difference at all.
: Surely you’ve seen the light penetrate the water, yes? Like the untouched flesh of a young girl’s pussy as it’s claimed by her older brother in the dead of the night?
: None of it’s consensual, Akira. The water wants to hide behind itself — just as that girl did beneath her covers.
: But the fact that it happens against one’s will doesn’t change the fact that it still feels good.
: I believe I may have been sodomized yesterday. By the world itself.

: And all the while, everyone got to look on and watch. Calling me “odd” or “unusual” due to the lack of verbal venom and the somewhat seductive soothsaying that combined into a tangible entity who didn’t show up for work.
: I am so lost right now.
: Yes...aren’t we all?
scene stripswimwar21
: For we, too, are transitory. We know where we’re from...we know where we’ll end up. And we also know when we’re in motion.
: Yet, if you remove just one of those three prongs, what you get is something that seems more fiction than fact. Do you understand what I’m alluding to, Akira?
: No. Please explain it in terms that even a pathetic layman like me can grasp.
scene stripswimwar22
: Akira — I believe that infinity itself may wear thigh-highs.
: And I believe you can fuck it if the right wish is made at the right time.
: Ask me how.
scene stripswimwar23
: Maybe later. I think some girls are about to take their clothes off for me.
: Yes...what a shame it would be to miss that.
scene stripswimwar24
: Welcome one, welcome all — to the single greatest finale to ever grace the Dorm Wars! And the most unsafe safe space to ever be...safe in!
: This is the den of debauchery! It’s the room the final boss is found in! But who is that final boss, you ask?!
scene stripswimwar25
: It’s that guy all the way over there! The one...the only...Sensei! Also known as Akira Arakawa or, if your name is Ami, Dad! Or maybe “Sir” if your name is Molly!
: Fact is — he has many names! And many qualities that each and every one of us have grown to either love or hate!
: Which is why today, the gloves come off! And we acknowledge once and for all that THIS IS WAR! That we all want him as the prize!
scene stripswimwar24
: Girls of 1-A! Long gone are the days of silently wondering who likes who! Long gone are the days of wet uncertainty!
: Is that term just a thing now? Is this what the young people are saying?
: We have reached a new era! One of unity! One of family! But most importantly — one where we are free to make bad decisions!
: For everyone in this room, including me, acknowledges here and now that we want a piece of that teacher and we don’t care who knows it!
: Eh.
: Except Otoha apparently!
scene stripswimwar26
: Now! It is my pleasure to announce the first of our two final competitions — a one on one swimsuit battle that Wakana or Imani can’t interrupt when it gets weird!
: Ladies and Sensei! Give it up for the tallest and arguably most proportionally flawless girl in school! Tsuneyo Tojo!
scene stripswimwar27
: The perfection of this body is inarguable. I could defeat each and every one of you in hand to hand combat with both hands tied behind my back.
: I don’t think it’d be “hand to hand” then.
: It would be if I fought backwards.
: Tsuneyo’s got more underboob than I have boob in general. Otoha — do ya think God hates me?
: Kirin! Your redemption arc begins now! Feel free to ask Tsuneyo whatever kinky questions you want without the fear of disappointing your sister!
: Tsuneyo! Question one — if you had to choose one girl in the class to violently scissor with, who would it be?
: Touka Tsukioka. Her hair is the longest now that the strawberry princess, Arborea, has become a boy.
: Tch. Touka’s not even here. I can’t watch her reaction.
: I’m also pretty sure Tsuneyo thinks “scissoring” is cutting someone’s hair.
: Tsuneyo, just to set the record straight, I would like to be the first to inform you that “scissoring” is the act of two girls rubbing their genitals together.
scene stripswimwar28
: Ridiculous. That sounds not only difficult, but minimally pleasurable. What a pointless sexual act.
: Right, sure. But knowing it is a sexual act, does it change your answer at all?
: Are you asking me, a straight woman, which female classmate I would most prefer to engage in Lebanese sex with?
: Well, not if you’re gonna make me sound like an asshole for it.
: The logical answer is Ami Arakawa.
: I am not sexually interested in her, but my love for her legs is undeniable and she is the closest to what I have already experienced in the realm of lesbianism.
: Uhh...Ami?
: I have literally no idea what she’s talking about, but I’m flattered.
scene stripswimwar29
: It should’ve been me.
: This marks the second time you have outwardly expressed explicit desire for the body of the Kendo Princess.
: I understand completely. But I am surprised that these expressions extend outwardly into a world where I was under the assumption you only had eyes for the overlord.
: Why does everyone just assume that about me now?
: Were you not listening to Uta’s speech just now?
: Of course not. She talks too much.
: Thanks, Maya!
: Tsuneyo! I have a question now — what are your thoughts on polycules vs monogamous relationships? Which would you rather be involved in?
: I know nothing of either. I’m just here to fuck, bro.
: Preach.
: Oh shut up, Kirin. We both know your biggest fetish is being called a good girl while getting lovingly penetrated in the missionary position.
: That-
: By your sister. Forgot to mention that part.
: Just to...satisfy my own curiosity, you are still a virgin...right, Tsuneyo?
scene stripswimwar30
: That is a good question, Nithhala.
: I do not know.
: How do you not know?!
: It is complicated and involves the supernatural. You would not understand even if I told you.
scene black
: The...supernatural?
: If that counts elves then Futaba ain’t a virgin either. Callin’ it.
: Miku! That’s- well...you’re not wrong. But they obviously don’t count!
scene stripswimwar31
: Tsuneyo! Question three — what sort of mythical creature would you most wanna get it on with?
: I am impressed by the battle prowess and strength put on display by my competitor’s character — Zagull Throat Spear. This is my final answer.
: I am writing this into the campaign as soon as I get home.
: Question four — why are you so good at modeling? You’re like a natural up there with all of these poses. I struggle just taking topless selfies.
: I’ve told you like twenty times I’d help with those.
: You’re not always around, okay?! Sometimes, I just want to take them myself.
: The convenience of natural beauty is looking exceptional no matter what pose you make. I won the moment I stepped on this stage.
: If you believe I am talented, however, I will accept the compliment and repay you with one of my own. Your eyes are very circular.
: Thank...you?
: You are welcome. This concludes both the modeling and questioning portions of the contest. I am very embarrassed.
scene black
: Really? You don’t seem embarrassed at all.
: It takes a great deal to make Tsuneyo blush, I’ve learned. I have touched her body more than anyone can imagine and she barely reacts.
: You’re not looking to switch rooms, are you?
: No, but I welcome you to come get measured whenever you like. I will be as thorough as I am allowed to be.
: Yeah, not what I had in mind.
: Would you really just leave me for Tsuneyo, Maya? That hurts my-
: Sana! What the hell is that?!
scene stripswimwar32
: Sorry. Hold that thought.
: There’s no way that even counts as a swimsuit! It is way too small! It barely covers anything!
: To be fair, there ain’t much there to begin with. Sana’s doin’ justice to us late bloomers! Ain’t that right, Ami?
: I can see nothing but pain.
: I think I...ordered the wrong size...
: Maybe I’m an...extra extra extra small now instead of an...extra extra extra extra small...
: Hah...
: You still came out here wearing that, though! What happened to keeping yourself covered up?! You never used to expose yourself to anybody! Let alone Sensei!
scene stripswimwar33
: It’s a...little embarrassing having all of you see me like this, but...I don’t mind at all...if it’s Sensei...
: He can see...as much of me as...he wants...whenever he wants to...
: But it’s not like there’s much to see in general, so...I guess I’ll just congratulate Tsuneyo now...
: Well...it’s more than she was wearing at the...other thing we went to.
: Shh! Sana! Question one — how do you feel about polycules vs. monogamous relationships?
: Are you just going to ask that to everyone now? What are you planning?
: I...don’t think I’m...interested in that stuff...
: If I’m going to have a boyfriend or...a girlfriend...I think I’d want them all to myself.
scene stripswimwar34
: That said...if I wasn’t...enough for that person...maybe I could be okay with...someone else joining us sometimes?...
: Futaba, you didn’t bring any-
: Here is a tissue, Rin. I had a feeling you would need one at some point tonight.
scene black
: Thank you...
: You really are my best friend...
scene stripswimwar35
: Question two or...we’re at two, right? I’m having a hard time focusing for some reason.
: It’s okay...I’m a little nervous too...
: Uhh...s...spit or swallow?!
scene stripswimwar36
: Neither...I’d want Sensei- I mean...my boyfriend...to let it out somewhere else...I’m just worried it wouldn’t fit...
: I am going to throw up.
: It’ll be okay, Ayane. No one here has ever been innocent. It was only a matter of time until Sana became unrecognizable to you.
: That doesn’t mean I have to like it, though!
scene stripswimwar37
: It’s not fair if...all of you get to say...suggestive things and I...have to keep my thoughts to myself...
: I need to catch up...and if Sensei is ever going to look at me...he needs to know there’s nothing any of you can do for him that I can’t do better...
: Are you looking at me, Sensei?...
: You are...right?
scene stripswimwar38
: Ahem. Question three — how will you celebrate your victory if Sensei chooses you tonight?
: I don’t know if I can...say what I’d do out loud...but it’d make me very happy and...I’d have to do something to let those feelings out when I get home...
: This was a mistake. I underestimated how horny everyone in this class is.
: Dear God...what have I done?
: Question whatever — which girl would you scissor with? Say me.
: Maaaaaaybe...Ami?
scene stripswimwar39
: God fucking damn it! Why do they keep picking you?! I’m so much more scissorable!
: Heck if I know! This is the first time Sana’s expressed that sort of interest in me at all! It’s gotta be the hair.
: Well, Ayane won’t do it with me, so...
scene stripswimwar40
: Ami’s straight too! At least pick a girl who wants to do stuff like that!
: Fine...I’ll do it with Noriko then. I feel like she’d be good at it and we could...really help each other out.
scene black
: God fucking damn it!
: Woohoo! Thanks, Sana! I agree. I would be good at it. But alas — my heart belongs to someone else.
: R...Right! But who does his heart belong to?!
scene stripswimwar41
Tsuneyo drags me over to the stage on her way back to make one of the hardest choices of my life.
So hard, in fact, that I am going to make a proposal that will likely be instantly rejected.
: I need to see them naked.
scene stripswimwar42
: Same! But also, denied! For this is a “swimsuit” competition! And I had to keep all of my clothes on when I did this!
: But if Sensei says he needs to see us like that...
: I have no interest in taking off all of my clothes. I am too busy feeling like a giant beside the two of you miniature humans.
: The time has come, Sensei! Is flat really justice?! Or will the buxom beauty of this bronze-skinned babe prevail in the name of breasthood?! You decide!
: Who takes the crown in our first of two modeling competitions?!
: Hah...
: You know, I’m still not really comfortable with the...openness on display tonight.
: But I am here to do a job and I feel that job would not be complete if I did not choose-
menu:
Sana
: ...Sana as the winner.
scene stripswimwar43
: Really?...I could have sworn you’d choose Tsuneyo...
: This is blasphemous. I have been robbed. What is the point of being born perfect if I can not use it to my advantage in fashion contests?
: Well, Sana — you did it. And all you had to do was wear essentially nothing on stage.
: Is there anything you’d like to say to the fans back home before we wrap this baby up and move onto the finale?
: Just that...I’m happy it was me...
: And that I’ve maybe been...a little too...dismissive about...certain things a...certain person has said to me...
: I’d like to know more...
: I’ve always loved...learning things from...my favorite teacher...

Tsuneyo

scene stripswimwar44
: Naturally.
: Seriously?
: It’s a swimsuit contest and hers is just the nicer swimsuit.
: Plus, it’s hard to deny the allure of her body. Which isn’t to say that there’s no allure to yours. It’s just-
: Small and pathetic when compared to that of a real woman.
: Now, let’s not get ahead of ourselves. There’s plenty to love about lolis! It just seems like today is not their day.
: So, Tsunecchi! I ask you this — is there anything you’d like to say to the fans back home before we wrap this baby up and move onto the finale?
: No.
: Not...Not even a little thing.
: Fine. I will provide one small comment for the tabloid. And it is that I have accepted I will one day bed this man.
scene stripswimwar45
: And I imagine it will ruin other women for him for the rest of his life. The end.
: I...I don’t think we can put that...on the app...but, uhh...

Ayane

scene stripswimwar46
: Sensei! Stop! You’re really starting to embarrass me!
: Wow. You’re, uhh...really into Ayane today, aren’t you?
: It is my personal mission to ensure that everyone looks back on this installment of the Dorm Wars as the one where Ayane won everything.
: She’s worn a swimsuit before. It counts.
: No it doesn’t! Choose Sana or Tsuneyo! Preferably Tsuneyo so you don’t encourage Sana to keep wearing things like this!
: Fine.
: Thank you!
: I choose Ayane again.
: AAAAAAAH!!!
: I mean, like...it’d be rude if I got mad about this, but...
: An interesting and unexpected choice. Albeit the wrong one as I am the clear winner.
: Regardless, I support your decision and concede.
: I guess...Ayane wins again then!
